## Outcome

What single user or product outcome do all children combine to deliver?

## Why this is an Epic

- [ ] The outcome is too large for one issue and one shippable unit.
- [ ] At least two real child issues already exist.
- [ ] Every child contributes to the same outcome rather than only sharing a Track or theme.
